types.name: MessageScrollerProps
types.doc: The scroll area of a conversation. While the reader is at the bottom it follows new content (new messages and text that is still streaming). Scrolling up lets go, so reading is never interrupted; a pill then counts what arrived and jumps back to the latest. Give it a height through `className`, `style` or the `--message-scroller-height` variable.

members.name: children
members.doc: The messages. Each direct child counts as one message for the unread count; give them stable keys.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the scroll area.

members.name: threshold
members.doc: How close to the bottom, in pixels, still counts as being at the bottom.

members.name: jumpLabel
members.doc: Text of the pill that returns to the newest message.

members.name: animateItems
members.doc: New messages rise in as they are added. Messages present on the first render never animate.

members.name: fadeEdges
members.doc: Fades the top and bottom edges while there is more content in that direction.

members.name: onAtBottomChange
members.doc: Called when the reader leaves or returns to the bottom.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.

members.name: style
members.doc: Inline style for the root element, for example a height.
